name: Undead Slayer (Pharasma)
source: Ultimate Campaign pg. 64, Advanced Player's Guide pg. 333
body:
Drawbacks
Undead Slayer (Pharasma)
Source Ultimate Campaign pg. 64, Advanced Player's Guide pg. 333
Category Religion
Requirement(s) Pharasma
Instructed at a young age in the tenets of the faith of Pharasma, you view the undead as abominations that must be destroyed so their souls can journey beyond to be judged. You gain a +1 trait bonus on weapon damage rolls against undead.
